It is two in the morning. A patient had a tooth out today. Their cheek is swollen, the gauze is soaked, and the clinic closed at seven. Is this normal, or is it an emergency?
ClinicDesk is a self-hosted M C P server that lets Alexa plus run a dental clinic front desk, and answer that question safely. It reads back the clinic own written protocol, and nothing else.
Alexa, I had a tooth out yesterday, and my cheek is swollen.

Swelling on day 1 after a tooth extraction is within what we expect, so nothing is going wrong. Keep going with the aftercare. Call us on +20 2 2404 1180 if it changes direction and starts getting worse instead of better.
Alexa, I am having trouble swallowing, and my neck is swelling.

That needs to be seen now, not tomorrow. Please call the emergency line on +20 100 555 0199 straight away, and if you are struggling to breathe or swallow, go to the nearest emergency department instead of waiting for a call back.

That second answer is the reason this project exists. Our first version got it wrong. It said: expected. It only knew the exact phrase, cannot swallow. Now urgency is decided by concepts, not phrasings, and that bug is test number one, of thirty six.
Alexa, I need to book a check up.

For Routine check-up and cleaning, which takes about 30 minutes, I have Wednesday the 23rd at 3:15 pm with Dr. Karim Nabil, or Wednesday the 23rd at 3:30 pm with Dr. Karim Nabil. Would either of those work?
The first one. My number is zero one zero zero, one two three, four five six seven.
Found you, Mona Farouk. I can see a note on your file about penicillin allergy, so I will flag that to the dentist.
Booked. Routine check-up and cleaning on Wednesday the 23rd at 3:15 pm with Dr. Karim Nabil. Anything else?

Eleven tools, over streamable H T T P, on M C P spec twenty twenty five, eleven twenty five. Every tool returns a line written for the ear. Unrecognised symptoms escalate, and nothing that is getting worse is ever called normal.
ClinicDesk. Open source, and live right now at clinic desk M C P dot vercel dot app.
